gui.commandhelperplus.config.title: Command Helper Plus Settings
gui.commandhelperplus.config.spyglass.to:
Displays advanced command suggestions via SpyglassMC in addition to vanilla suggestions.
When off, only vanilla suggestions will be displayed.
If vanilla 'Command Suggestions' is off in chat settings, this is disabled regardless.
Automatically inserts closing brackets and quotes when entering [ { ".
Also applies when selecting suggestions (Tab) that contain opening brackets.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.history_lim:
Maximum number of commands to keep in command history (command_history.txt and up/down chat history).
Click to cycle through presets (50 / 100 / 250 / 500 / 1000 / 2500 / 5000 / 10000 / 50000 / 100000).
Vanilla default is 50. Reducing this does not truncate existing history until next command execution.
You can also set any value between 1 and 100000 in config file.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.skip_histor:
Directly deletes history items when clicking [x] without showing confirmation screen.
Removing favorites (which loses key bindings) always requires confirmation regardless of this setting.
Deleted history cannot be restored (deleted from both file and chat history).
gui.commandhelperplus.config.long_comman:
Raises chat input limit for commands (starting with /) from vanilla 256 characters.
Regular chat messages remain capped at 256. Takes effect next time chat is opened.
Signed commands (like /say or /msg) are safely truncated to 256 to prevent errors.
Maximum limit can be changed via maxCommandLength (256-32767) in config file.
Turn off if your server rejects long command packets.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.preview.too:
Displays targeted command block content (including minecarts) on screen.
Requires operator permissions (level 2+); nothing is displayed without op.
Queries the server approximately every 2 seconds.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.syntax.tool:
Underlines syntax and type errors in the command being typed (errors in red, warnings in yellow).
Hover over underlined text to view error details.
Disabled if Spyglass Suggestions is turned off.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.translucent:
Renders invisible entities (under Invisibility effect or Invisible tag) as translucent even without Spectator mode.
Works using information sent by server, op is not required.
Armor and held items remain unchanged.
May be considered unfair on multiplayer servers.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.nametag.too:
Forces entity nametags to display, ignoring team settings (nameTagVisibility), Invisible and Sneaking behind walls.
Ignoring invisibility hiding only applies when 'Translucent Invisible Entities' is enabled.
Entities without names will not show nametags.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.marker.tool:
Displays particle crosshairs at marker positions visible only to you.
Since markers are not synced by server, runs periodic queries requiring op (level 2+).
Commands may appear in server console. Results are hidden from chat.
Radius and interval can be configured in config file.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.scoreboard_:
Displays multiple scoreboards at once on the top-left of screen (vanilla sidebar only shows 1).
Since server only syncs displayed slot, periodically queries scoreboard players list requiring op (level 2+).
Commands may appear in server console.
Click to open Scoreboard HUD configuration screen.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.skip_experi: Skips experimental confirmation screens and proceeds acknowledging the risks.
gui.commandhelperplus.config.open_config:
Opens config/commandhelperplus.properties with default OS app.
If it cannot open, please use 'Open Config Folder' on the right.
Game restart required after editing the file.
gui.commandhelperplus.scoreboard_hud.ena:
Displays multiple scoreboards at once on top-left of screen (vanilla sidebar only shows 1).
Since server only syncs displayed slot, periodically executes scoreboard players list requiring op (level 2+).
Results are hidden from chat. Commands may appear in server console.
Nothing will be displayed if game rule sendCommandFeedback is false.
gui.commandhelperplus.scoreboard_hud.obj:
Enter objective names separated by commas (up to %s).
Only alphanumeric characters and _ - + . are allowed.
Please specify internal objective name, not display name.
gui.commandhelperplus.scoreboard_hud.sel:
Selector to inspect scores for (default @a).
Example: @a[team=red] / @e[type=zombie]. Must start with @ and have no spaces outside [ ].
Defaults to @a if invalid.
gui.commandhelperplus.scoreboard_hud.hol:
Names of fake players not covered by selectors, separated by commas.
Queried individually (up to %s).
Query interval increases with more players. Spaces, quotes, and names starting with @ or * cannot be used.
gui.commandhelperplus.scoreboard_hud.max:
Maximum rows displayed per objective, sorted descending by score.
Click to cycle through 3 / 5 / 8 / 10 / 15.
Query interval in multiplayer can be adjusted in config (20-600 ticks).
Singleplayer updates immediately without delay.
